findings.description: The conditional expression binds as `(frequency + title_bonus) if term in title_terms else 0.0`, so every term that does not appear in the title is scored 0.0 instead of its relative frequency. Before this change those terms were ranked by frequency. Now they all tie at 0.0 and are ordered alphabetically. In tagger.suggest_tags, the MIN_SCORE filter (0.05) then drops every such term, so suggestions are limited to words that appear in the title. Body keywords are effectively never suggested, and the `limit` slots are filled with zero-score terms that are then discarded. The returned Keyword.score values also change meaning for existing callers of extract_keywords.
findings.suggestion: Score every term with its frequency and add the bonus only for title terms: `scores[term] = frequency + title_bonus if term in title_terms else frequency`.
findings.title: Body-only terms get score 0.0, so frequency ranking is lost
